topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: The paths of the forest are tangled, the underbrush dense and watching. I move with shadows, my breath silent, heart beating against the chill of the air. The shape of the world feels different, the scent of earth and leaves sharpened by an unknown wind. A presence lingers at the edge of my senses, not quite visible but close. The trees whisper of change, of secrets unfolding in the light of an unfamiliar sky. I must stay hidden, must not reveal the quiet of my steps. The world is vast, and the space I know is shrinking, as if the forest itself draws tighter around me.
